decisions.reason: As a distant diversification from ship management into non-maritime recruitment, it is unlikely to meet aspiration levels quickly enough to justify scarce managerial attention, so a large but disciplined German maritime services firm would reallocate those resources to closer opportunities.

Because superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm’s crewing capabilities, customer base and international network, and the firm currently has growth and slack, management would tolerate early uncertainty and keep it on the market.
